approach: Reimplement the paper's pipeline from the claim contract because no author code exists. The critical path is the full-feature stack for C1-C3: load and validate the Full-Filled Brain Stroke dataset, hard-code the Table-2 label map, apply IQR cleaning to the continuous columns, split 80/20 stratified with random_state=42, scale continuous features on train only, apply SMOTE to train only, build 10-fold OOF probability meta-features from Random Forest, XGBoost, LightGBM and SVC, and train a logistic-regression meta-learner. Baselines C4-C6 are single LightGBM runs on the full, correlation-selected and RF-selected feature sets; C7 is the paper's alternate RF-selected stack. reproduce.py calls the shared experiment runner and writes results/metrics.json with C1's accuracy and the C2/C3/other claim metrics. Use Table 7/R14 fixed hyperparameters for the final C1 run, with an optional GridSearchCV verification script for R8.

files.purpose: Extra packages beyond the pre-installed stack: imbalanced-learn, xgboost, lightgbm, kagglehub, joblib.
Single source of truth: paths, seed, Table-2 label maps, feature lists, split/SMOTE/CV/OOF settings, fixed base-model and meta-learner hyperparameters, claim targets.
Acquire the public Full-Filled Brain Stroke CSV via kagglehub/Kaggle API, copy it to data/stroke.csv, and validate shape, columns and target.

Load/validate data, apply hard-coded Table-2 encoding, IQR outlier removal on continuous columns, build full/correlation/RF feature sets, stratified 80/20 split, train-only StandardScaler, train-only SMOTE.
Factories for RandomForest, XGBoost, LightGBM, SVC, LogisticRegression meta-learner, and the alternate C7 base learners; all hyperparameters imported from config.

Optional R8 verification: stratified 5-fold GridSearchCV optimizing ROC-AUC for the four C1 base learners; writes results/tuning.json and does not change the final Table 7 fixed C1 model unless explicitly requested.
Build 10-fold stratified OOF predicted probabilities, fit meta-learner, refit base learners on full SMOTE train, predict test probabilities and classes at threshold 0.5.
Compute accuracy, precision, recall, F1, ROC-AUC and confusion matrix; compare C1-C7 claims to targets and write pass/fail fields.
Orchestrate the full run: C1-C3 full-feature stack, C4 full-feature LightGBM, C5 correlation LightGBM, C6 RF-selected LightGBM, C7 alternate RF-selected stack; supports --smoke and --check modes.
Entrypoint: run the full experiment and write results/metrics.json; --smoke runs a tiny data-flow test.

config.seed: 42 (A6; used for split, SMOTE, OOF folds, RF, XGBoost, LightGBM, SVC, LR)

dataset.expected_raw_rows: 4981 (R1; warn and stop to reconcile if the downloaded Full-Filled variant has a different row count)

label_maps.source: R2/Table 2; hard-coded, never sklearn LabelEncoder default

outlier_removal.fit_on: full cleaned dataset before the train/test split (A4)
outlier_removal.expected_rows_after: 4337 (R3; log actual and stop if far off)

feature_sets.correlation_source: R4/A7; Table 4's 7 listed correlation features, including work_type and excluding avg_glucose_level
feature_sets.rf_selected: top 7 by RandomForestClassifier(n_estimators=200, min_samples_split=2, random_state=42) fit on cleaned full data before split (R4; log the exact selected list)

smote.apply_to: training set only, before 5-fold CV and before 10-fold OOF (A5/R7)
smote.expected_balanced_total: 6624 with 3312 per class if the split matches Table 6 (R7; log actual and do not fail if row counts differ slightly)

gridsearch.enabled_in_reproduce: false; final C1 uses Table 7 fixed values (A3)

oof.meta_features: predicted P(stroke=1) from each base model, not hard labels (R11)

secondary_c7_stack.note: C7 config in claim contract; run after C1-C6 if time remains

steps: Create the project skeleton and install extras with `pip install -r requirements.txt` (or `pip install imbalanced-learn xgboost lightgbm kagglehub joblib`).
Implement config.py exactly as above, including the hard-coded Table-2 label maps and the fixed Table 7/R14 model hyperparameters.

Implement download_data.py. Try kagglehub.dataset_download('zzettrkalpakbal/full-fi-lled-brain-stroke-dataset'); if unavailable, try the Kaggle API with KAGGLE_USERNAME/KAGGLE_KEY; if a local data/raw CSV exists, use it. Copy the found CSV to data/stroke.csv. Validate 4,981 rows and 11 expected columns, or stop with a clear blocker message.
Implement data_utils.py. Load data/stroke.csv, apply config.label_maps to the categorical columns, and assert no unmapped category remains. Do not call sklearn LabelEncoder.
Apply IQR removal on age, avg_glucose_level and bmi using the full cleaned dataset before splitting (A4). Log row count before/after and target counts; expect ~4,337 rows.

Build the three feature sets from config. For rf_selected, fit RandomForestClassifier(n_estimators=200, min_samples_split=2, random_state=42) on cleaned full data and take the top 7 importances; log the selected names. Use the fixed Table-4 correlation list for the correlation set.

For each feature set used, split 80/20 with stratify=stroke and random_state=42. Fit StandardScaler on the training continuous columns only, transform train/test, then apply SMOTE(k_neighbors=5, random_state=42) to the training set only. Verify the untouched test set still has 868 rows and original prevalence.

Implement models.py with the four C1 base learners and logistic meta-learner. Implement stacking.py: run StratifiedKFold(n_splits=10, shuffle=True, random_state=42) on the SMOTE-balanced training set, collect each base learner's validation P(stroke=1) into an OOF matrix, fit LogisticRegression on the OOF matrix, refit each base learner on the full SMOTE training set, predict test probabilities, and threshold the meta-probability at 0.5.

Implement evaluate.py to compute accuracy, precision, recall, F1, ROC-AUC and the confusion matrix on the untouched test set, using stroke=1 as the positive class. Include helper to write claim values in percent and check C1 against 97.2 +/- 2.0.

Implement run_experiments.py orchestration. The main run executes C1-C3 on the full-feature stack, C4 with a single full-feature LightGBM, C5 with a correlation-feature LightGBM, C6 with an RF-selected LightGBM, and then C7 using the secondary RF-selected stack if time permits.
Implement reproduce.py. Default mode calls the full experiment and writes results/metrics.json. `--smoke` mode runs the tiny data-flow test. `--check` mode runs only intermediate checks and exits.
Run `python reproduce.py --smoke` first. Fix data-flow errors before any full fit.

Run `python reproduce.py --check` and inspect all intermediate checks: raw shape, category maps, IQR row count, test size, SMOTE class counts, OOF matrix shape, finite probabilities, and majority-class baseline.

Optionally run `python tune.py --quick` for R8 verification. It performs stratified 5-fold GridSearchCV with ROC-AUC over the small config grids and writes results/tuning.json; the final C1 run still uses the fixed Table 7 values unless the runner is explicitly told to use best_params.

Run `python reproduce.py`. Confirm results/metrics.json contains C1 accuracy, C2 F1, C3 ROC-AUC, C4-C7 baseline accuracies, the exact config, dataset counts, selected RF features, and the C1 pass/fail against 97.2 +/- 2.0.

If C1 misses the tolerance, inspect the non-test side only: verify SMOTE was train-only, OOF used probabilities, SVC probability=True, Table 7 hyperparameters were used, and the test set was never rescaled or resampled. Do not tune on the test set.
smoke_test: `python reproduce.py --smoke` uses a stratified 300-row subset, test_size=0.2, SMOTE k_neighbors=2, 2-fold OOF, n_estimators=10 for RF/XGB/LGBM, max_iter=100 for LR/MLP, and skips GridSearch and C7. It must print and write results/smoke_metrics.json with non-empty OOF shape (n_train_smoke, 4), finite probabilities in [0,1], a confusion matrix, and accuracy/F1/ROC-AUC for the tiny stack.
intermediate_checks: Raw CSV exists and has shape (4981, 11) with columns gender, age, hypertension, heart_disease, ever_married, work_type, Residence_type, avg_glucose_level, bmi, smoking_status, stroke.
Target prevalence is approximately 4-5% stroke; print exact counts. A DummyClassifier(strategy='prior') accuracy should be near the majority-class share and its ROC-AUC near 0.5.
Table-2 hard-coded encoding leaves no NaN and no unmapped category strings; compare value sets before/after mapping.
IQR removal on age/avg_glucose_level/bmi reduces the dataset to approximately 4,337 rows; log exact before/after and target counts.
Each 80/20 stratified split has a test set of 868 rows with stroke prevalence matching train (R5).
SMOTE is applied only after split and only to train; log original train class counts and balanced train class counts (Table 6 target: 3,312/3,312, total 6,624 if the split matches).
10-fold OOF probability matrix for C1 has shape (n_smote_train, 4), no NaNs, all values in [0,1], and each column has both classes represented.
SVC is instantiated with probability=True; otherwise OOF meta-features cannot be built.
Meta-learner output probabilities are finite and the 0.5 threshold produces a sensible confusion matrix; log predicted positive rate.
Single-model LightGBM on full features should beat the majority baseline substantially, and C1 stack should be at least as strong as the best single model before claiming the stack result.
budget_plan: Setup and dataset acquisition: 4-6 min. Smoke test and intermediate checks: 3-4 min. Optional GridSearchCV verification: 2-3 min, skippable if time is tight. Full C1-C6 run: 12-18 min on CPU. C7 alternate stack: 3-5 min only if the main run is already within budget. Reporting and JSON validation: 1 min. If the total approaches 30 min, skip tune.py and C7; C1-C3 are already produced by the main full-feature stack run.
